content.rendered:
If you missed the virtual kindergarten Parent Information night you can view the slide show here. If you have additional questions, please call the office at 503-825-5302.

Registration for 2021-2022 Kindergarten is now available online. A paper packet is available in the school office. Please call 503-825-5300 to request a paper packet or for more information.
